'''Chashima''' was a temperate and [[Forest/Legends|forested]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with fields of drymoss in the [[Chashima system/Legends|Chashima system]] of the [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] set up a research facility for [[Shaper caste|shapers]] working on the [[commbuzzer]], a type of [[Beetle/Legends|beetle]] designed to home in on [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] transmissions. The facility was [[Mission to Chashima|sabotaged]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]] by [[Wraith Squadron]], but the operation came at the cost of Wraiths [[Estoric Sandskimmer]] and [[Hohass Ekwesh]].<ref name="XWMK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chashima made its first appearance in the [[2012]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', written by [[Aaron Allston]].<ref name="XWMK" />
